reader.requirement: At 1985, ADD CORRESPONDING identifier-1 TO identifier-2 adds each elementary numeric item of group identifier-1 to the corresponding item of group identifier-2 (correspondence per VI.6.4.3: same name and qualifiers, both elementary numeric, items with REDEFINES, RENAMES, OCCURS or USAGE INDEX and their subordinates ignored, FILLER excluded) and stores the sum there, with ROUNDED and SIZE ERROR applying per pair; both operands must be groups and not reference modified.

edition-consulted.switches: perPair = MOVE and DialectLevel < 2002: per-pair group identification is MOVE-only below 2002; ADD at 85 takes the identify-once arm, the same as 2023

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|CobolVersion in CorrespondingBinder.cs and CorrespondingEmitter.cs (emitter: none)
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: addc2 prints the same at --std 85 and --std 2023 (identification once, per-pair size error)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: witnesses cover values, FILLER groups, OCCURS/REDEFINES subordinates and the subscript-once rule; not USAGE INDEX exclusion, numeric-edited/alphanumeric namesakes, scaled P items, ROUNDED, per-pair SIZE ERROR, 18-digit extremes, an ODO table operand

probes.printed: SIZE ERROR; N1 +0087.50 N2 010 NE   4 ALF 005 N3 12 N4 24 T1 33 R1 55 R2 06 IX 07 P1 2.3 SC 0305 ONLY2 77 BIG 002; source unchanged; second ADD N2 017
probes.expected: signed/scaled/P pairs summed, ROUNDED 1.0+1.25=2.3, edited and alphanumeric namesakes, OCCURS, REDEFINES, FILLER and USAGE INDEX items ignored, BIG overflow leaves 002 and SIZE ERROR runs
R (I OF B) in an ODO table identified once (I 2, J 5), 18-digit +max + -max = 0; second ADD: BIGN and J overflow (size error, unchanged), I 1+0

probes.printed: COBOL1757 'EL' is an elementary item; COBOL1757 'G1(1:2)' is reference-modified
probes.expected: refused: VI.6.6.3 SR1 each identifier a group item; VI.6.4.3 D1 not reference modified

reader.notes: All pairs and exclusions match VI.6.4.3; the ADD arm is edition-independent and equals 2023 output. The refusal messages at --std 85 cite §2023 clauses rather than §1985 (cosmetic, not a conformance defect).

refuter.evidence: Probes refute-1985-238/raddc1.cob (runs/raddc1-002) and raddc2.cob (runs/raddc2-001) at --std 85. raddc1 printed 'N5 01 N6 02 XR 03 NB -00036 N7 35 N11 56': an item under SUBA in G1 against a same-name item directly in G2 and under SUBB are not corresponding (VI.6.4.3 rule 1, same qualifiers), a level-66 RENAMES of G1 is ignored (rule 4), COMP to COMP-3 and the same-named SUBC.N11 add; subscripted D1/D2 'E1 33 +06 E2 22 +09' and ADD CORR ENT (2) TO ENT (2) doubled 'E2 44 +18'. raddc2 (D1 subscripted by K OF CTL, which the ADD itself changes as a corresponding item of D2) printed 'K 2 N8 10': the subscript is evaluated once as the first operation, which ADD CORR at 85 requires (it states no per-pair exception, unlike MOVE CORR VI.6.19.4 GR2).
